integrity: All determinant, gradient, Cayley, normalization, adjugate and conic identities used in the proof are replayed by the bundled exact symbolic verifier. Literature comparisons distinguish general kernel-sheaf theory from the explicit claim.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the displayed 3-by-3 symmetric tensor over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero; no positive-characteristic uniformity or family classification is claimed.
title: The accidentally essential cubic is cuspidal and its normalized kernel map is a conic
